    static int computeResult(int a, int b, int l, int r) {

            return a <= b ? a + 1 : (2 * a - b);
        }

        int[] pattern = new int[3 * (a + b) + 1];
        int currentVal = 0;

        // First segment: 1 to a
        for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
            pattern[i] = i;
            currentVal = i;
        }

        // Second segment: a+1 to a+b
        for (int i = a + 1; i <= a + b; i++) {
            pattern[i] = currentVal;
        }

        // Third segment: a+b+1 to a+b+a

            int candidate = 1;
            while (containsValue(pattern, candidate, a + 1, i - 1)) {
                candidate++;
            }
            pattern[i] = candidate;
            currentVal = candidate;
        }

        // Fourth segment: a+b+a+1 to a+b+a+b

            pattern[i] = currentVal;
        }

        // Fifth segment: 2*(a+b)+1 to 3*(a+b)
        for (int i = 2 * (a + b) + 1; i <= 3 * (a + b); i++) {
            pattern[i] = pattern[i - (a + b)];
        }

        // Count distinct values in range [l, r]
        boolean[] seen = new boolean[25];
        int start = l % (a + b);
        if (start == 0) start += (a + b);
        int end = r - l + start;
        if (end < start) end += (a + b);

        for (int i = start; i <= end; i++) {
            seen[pattern[i]] = true;
        }

        int count = 0;

            if (seen[i]) count++;
        }
        return count;
    }

    static boolean containsValue(int[] arr, int val, int left, int right) {
        for (int i = left; i <= right; i++) {
            if (arr[i] == val) return true;
        }
        return false;
